name: Shimotsuki Yukinari
source:
One of the original participants.

He is described as being a cowardly and even slightly gloomy person. He lacks confidence and startles easily. Despite this, many people find him easy to talk to. He's kind at heart and wants to help people. 

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Yukinari_Shimotsuki]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
